title: Adaptive responses of Bacillus subtilis underlie differential nanoplastic toxicity with implications for root colonization
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00936C, Paper
Franklin Perez, Nesha May O. Andoy, Uyan Tran Thao Hua, Keiko Yoshioka, Ruby May A. Sullan
The toxicity of nanoplastics bound to plant growth-promoting bacteria strongly depends on their mode of growth, significantly limiting their ability to colonize roots.
